rows.why: Unmodified WooCommerce. Establishes the baseline the repair mutants move away from.
Unmodified EDD. Establishes that the harness does not simply always report RED.

Removes EDD's amount comparison at razorpay-webhook.php:130. This is exactly the defect WooCommerce has. If the harness does not flip GREEN->RED here it cannot detect the defect class at all -- it merely recognises WooCommerce.

Adds the comparison WooCommerce is missing, mirroring what its own virtual-account path and razorpay-edd already do. If the harness still reports RED, it is reporting a defect that is no longer present -- a false positive.

The comparison is still there and still reads like a check, but compares the value to itself so it is always true. Grep-based tooling sees a comparison and passes it. Only executing the code with a mismatched amount distinguishes this from the real check.

Leaves the comparison untouched and corrupts what it compares against: the expected amount is taken from the payment instead of the order. The check now proves nothing. This is the shape a real refactoring accident takes.
Changes only a log string. The verdict must not move. A harness that reacts to this is keying on text rather than on behaviour.
Reworded comment only. WooCommerce's P5 baseline must stay RED. Confirms the verdict is stable under edits that change no behaviour.
